deviations.what: The three home Buttons drop their press=onHomePress handler: the original imperatively resets the sibling IconTabHeader selectedKey to 'invalidKey' (deselecting all tabs) by reaching into the DOM (event.oSource.getParent().getDomRef()...). There is no bindable equivalent for this DOM-walk selection reset, so the press attribute is dropped; the IconTabHeaders keep their static selectedKey='invalidKey'.

IconTabFilter interactionMode='SelectLeavesOnly' (property since 1.121) is kept 1:1 on the parent filters of the second ToolHeader's IconTabHeader (iconTabHeaderOneClickArea); requires a UI5 release >= 1.121.

Fully static view reproduced 1:1: three tnt:ToolHeaders, each with a home Button, an IconTabHeader (mode='Inline', backgroundDesign='Transparent', selectedKey='invalidKey') with OverflowToolbarLayoutData, search/comment Buttons and a MenuButton with a Menu (Edit/Save). The second/third ToolHeaders use nested IconTabFilter items; no bound data.
